tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return the authenticated Rapid Indexer account (id, email, credits balance, created date). Use it to check credits before creating tasks.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return live credit costs: credits per URL for standard/VIP indexing and index checking, traffic price per 1,000 visitors, USD per credit, and whether VIP/traffic are currently enabled.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the credit and USD cost of an indexing or index-check task before submitting it, and whether the account balance covers it. Does not create anything.

tools.name: submit_urls_for_indexing
tools.description: Create an indexing task: Rapid Indexer signals Googlebot to crawl each URL so Google discovers it fast. SPENDS CREDITS immediately (standard ~2 credits/URL, VIP ~10 credits/URL). Run estimate_cost first and confirm with the user for large batches. Standard queue starts within minutes; VIP starts imm

tools.name: check_index_status
tools.description: Create an index-check task that reports, per URL, whether Google currently has it in the index (indexed / unindexed). Cheap (~0.1 credit per URL) but still SPENDS CREDITS. Results arrive within a few minutes: poll get_task, then read get_task_links. Does not submit anything to Google; use submit_url

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List the account's tasks, newest first, with per-link counts (indexed / unindexed / pending / error). Filter by type or status. Use it to find task ids.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Fetch one task, refreshing its status from the provider first. Returns status (pending/processing/completed/failed) and progress counts. Poll this after creating a task.

tools.name: get_task_links
tools.description: Return each URL in an indexing or index-check task with its status (indexed / unindexed / pending / error). Filter by status and paginate with limit/offset for big tasks. Always includes a summary count.

tools.name: create_traffic_campaign
tools.description: Send AI-driven, human-like visitors to a URL (geo, device, referrer and on-page behaviour are configurable). SPENDS CREDITS immediately: see get_pricing (credits per 1,000 visitors). visitors/days must not exceed 1,000 per day. Confirm with the user before creating. Returns the task id; poll get_tas

tools.name: create_ctr_campaign
tools.description: Send visitors who search the given keywords on a search engine (Google by default), find the target URL in the results and click it, then browse like a human. SPENDS CREDITS immediately (same rate as traffic, per visitor). Confirm with the user before creating. Use list_search_engines for valid sear

tools.name: list_search_engines
tools.description: Return the search engines and marketplaces accepted by create_ctr_campaign.search_engine.

tools.name: check_service_health
tools.description: Ping the Rapid Indexer API and report version and enabled features (indexer, checker, traffic, ctr). Also validates that the configured API key works.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, get_pricing, submit_urls_for_indexing, check_index_status, get_task_links, create_ctr_campaign · Private data: check_service_health · Public sink: get_account, submit_urls_for_indexing, check_index_status, create_traffic_campaign, create_ctr_campaign · Destructive: submit_urls_for_indexing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, get_pricing, submit_urls_for_indexing, check_index_status, get_task_links, create_ctr_campaign · Private data: check_service_health · Public sink: get_account, submit_urls_for_indexing, check_index_status, create_traffic_campaign, create_ctr_campaign · Destructive: submit_urls_for_indexing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
